name: Palestine: Land of Olives and Vines – Cultural Landscape of Southern Jerusalem, Battir
description: Just southwest of Jerusalem, in the West Bank, the village of Battir sits among steep valleys stepped with stone terraces. Some terraces are watered by springs through ancient channels, with the water shared out among village families in turn, to grow vegetables, while dry slopes hold grapevines and olive trees. The system dates back to Roman times and is still farmed today, though the site is listed as endangered.
